```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ncvreg)
```


```{r}
rocket_dir_train <- "C:/Users/satavans/Downloads/alcohol_application/train_files/"
rocket_dir <- "C:/Users/satavans/Downloads/alcohol_application/"
for(i in 0:99){
  feats <- read.csv(file.path(rocket_dir_train, paste0("driving_split", i, ".csv")))
  y <- read.csv(file.path(rocket_dir_train, paste0("driving_split_y", i, ".csv")))
  y_list <- y$X0
  
  cvfit <- cv.ncvreg(feats,y_list,family = "binomial",penalty = "lasso")
  coef_opt <- coef(
      cvfit,
      lambda = cvfit$lambda.min
  )
  
  selected_features <- which(coef_opt[-1] != 0)
  selected_features
  
  fit <- ncvreg(feats,y_list,family = "binomial",penalty = "lasso")
  mfdr(fit, feats)
  df <- summary(fit, lambda = cvfit$lambda.min)
  
  df_filtered <- df$table %>%
    filter(mfdr < 0.001) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "feature")
  
  selected_features <- floor((selected_features[df_filtered$feature] - 1)/2)
  df2 <- data.frame(selected_features)
  
  write.csv(df2, file.path(rocket_dir, paste0("kernels_0.001/spike_kernels", i, ".csv")))
  print(i)
}

```

